passage.text: Mr. Brown grew up on a farm in Canada, near a small village.
passage.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈɡruː ˈʌp ɑːn ə ˈfɑːrm ɪn ˈkænədə, ˈnɪr ə ˈsmɔːl ˈvɪlɪdʒ.

passage.text: His family had cows, chickens and a big red barn.
passage.reading: hɪz ˈfæməli ˈhæd ˈkaʊz, ˈtʃɪkənz ənd ə ˈbɪɡ ˈrɛd ˈbɑːrn.

passage.text: "I remember waking up at five every morning to feed the cows," he says.
passage.reading: aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ˈweɪkɪŋ ˈʌp ət ˈfaɪv ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ tə ˈfiːd ðə ˈkaʊz, hiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: In summer, he used to drive the tractor with his father.
passage.reading: ɪn ˈsʌmər, hiː ˈjuːst tə ˈdraɪv ðə ˈtræktər wɪð hɪz ˈfɑːðər.

passage.text: He started when he was only twelve, and he loved it!
passage.reading: hiː ˈstɑːrtɪd wɛn hiː wʌz ˈoʊnli ˈtwɛlv, ənd hiː ˈlʌvd ɪt!

passage.text: In the fall, everyone helped with the harvest.
passage.reading: ɪn ðə ˈfɔːl, ˈɛvriwʌn ˈhɛlpt wɪð ðə ˈhɑːrvɪst.

passage.text: "It was hard work, but it was the best time of the year," he says.
passage.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈhɑːrd ˈwɜːrk, bʌt ɪt wʌz ðə ˈbɛst ˈtaɪm əv ðə ˈjɪr, hiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: Winters on the farm were long and cold.
passage.reading: ˈwɪntərz ɑːn ðə ˈfɑːrm wɜːr ˈlɔːŋ ənd ˈkoʊld.

passage.text: When it snowed, the children used to play in the barn.
passage.reading: wɛn ɪt ˈsnoʊd, ðə ˈtʃɪldrən ˈjuːst tə ˈpleɪ ɪn ðə ˈbɑːrn.

passage.text: Mr. Brown's family doesn't have the farm any more.
passage.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊnz ˈfæməli ˈdʌzənt ˈhæv ðə ˈfɑːrm ˈɛni ˈmɔːr.

passage.text: "But I still miss it," he says.
passage.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈstɪl ˈmɪs ɪt, hiː ˈsɛz.
